info.name: Forex Predictor WebSocket Relay
info.description:
Test collection for the Forex Predictor WebSocket relay.

Prerequisites:
- BFF server running on localhost:3000
- Backend API running on localhost:8000
- Postman v10+ with WebSocket support

The BFF proxies WebSocket connections from port 3000 to the backend on port 8000.

header.description: Required by the BFF origin check

request.description:
Connect to the BFF WebSocket relay and subscribe to BTC/USD 1-minute candles.

After connecting, send the subscribe message below.

Expected: CandleTick payloads with is_closed: false while forming, is_closed: true when complete.
